# lokalise_team_user (Data Source)

Looks up a Lokalise team user by email (case-insensitive), returning its `user_id` for use in `lokalise_team_user_group_member.user_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lokalise_team_user" "jane" {
  team_id = 123456
  email   = "jane@example.com"
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group_member" "jane" {
  team_id  = 123456
  group_id = lokalise_team_user_group.french_translators.group_id
  user_id  = data.lokalise_team_user.jane.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User's email address. Matched case-insensitively.
- `team_id` (Number) Team ID to look up the user in.

### Read-Only

- `fullname` (String) The user's full name.
- `role` (String) The user's team role.
- `user_id` (Number) The user's Lokalise ID.
